title: Channel Sales Manager
summary: A channel sales manager builds and runs the network of distributors, dealers and retailers that sells a company's products, and makes sure each partner earns a fair return. The role sits in the sales team of FMCG, consumer durables or telecom companies and reports to a regional or national sales head.
dailyDuties: Review secondary sales and stock at each distributor
Check distributor ROI, margins and pending claims
Meet dealers to negotiate schemes, credit and targets
Appoint new partners in towns with no coverage
Launch and track dealer incentive and loyalty schemes
Coach sales officers on outlet reach and collections

skills.expectation: Appoint, review and replace distributors and dealers in the region
Work out distributor ROI, margins and investment so partners stay profitable
Design and run dealer and retailer incentive and loyalty schemes
Add dealers and outlets in uncovered towns to grow retail reach
Drive primary billing to distributors and secondary sales to retailers
Control channel credit, collections and scheme claim settlement
Forecast monthly channel volumes and stock needs
Negotiate margins, credit terms and scheme payouts with channel partners
Lead a team of sales officers or territory managers who manage the channel
Build channel MIS, claim trackers and distributor ROI sheets in Excel
Track scheme spend against budget and measure its return
Read secondary sales and outlet data from DMS and SFA apps
Map towns and routes before appointing new partners
Coordinate with large-format retail where the channel overlaps
Build channel dashboards for regional reviews
